milestones.title: Deep crawl: async Apify job up to 100 pages per vendor
milestones.proof_description: Replace the synchronous n8n WCC webhook call (max 3 pages, 100s Cloudflare limit) with a direct async Apify job. The n8n webhook path remains as a fast fallback for vendors where deep crawl is not yet available. Prove by crawling 3 vendors to 100 pages and asserting the blob is stored in Supabase.

schema_additions.crawl_completed_at: timestamp — when deep crawl last ran

milestones.notes: This produces a first-party signal unique to SuccessByCS — not available anywhere else. More actionable for CS buyers than G2 star rating: tells you whether a vendor has 47 documented integration articles or 3. Scoring algorithm: (1) crawl help site, collect article titles + snippets; (2) LLM maps content to taxonomy dimensions; (3) raw dimension scores (0-10 each) summed; (4) percentile-rank within category -> 0-100 integer. milestones.title: Three-tier vendor site crawl as n8n/Apify pipeline (replace Python direct-HTTP)
milestones.proof_description: Replace the Python direct-HTTP vendor crawl (vendor_fetcher.py) with three dedicated n8n workflows, one per tier, ordered cheapest-first. Tier 1 (csp-crawl-tier1-direct): plain HTTP Request node — no Apify cost. Tier 2 (csp-crawl-tier2-rag): Apify RAG Web Browser — lightweight JS rendering. Tier 3 (csp-crawl-tier3-wcc): Apify Website Content Crawler with proxy — full stealth crawl. Python dispatch logic in vendor_fetcher.py: call Tier 1 first; escalate to Tier 2 if response is thin (< 200 words or missing og:site_name); escalate to Tier 3 if Tier 2 also fails. Also add csp-google-discovery n8n workflow (Apify Google Search Results Scraper) to replace direct SerpAPI calls in web_search.py. Tracxn enricher deprecated. Run end-to-end proof on 10 vendors.

csp-crawl-tier3-wcc.workflow.json: calls apify/website-content-crawler with proxyConfiguration, same output contract

Python dispatch: Tier 1 first -> escalate to Tier 2 if word_count < 200 or name missing -> escalate to Tier 3 if Tier 2 word_count < 200
